messages:
lina: quick triage thread for next week's model onboarding backlog. candidates: atlas-7b, aurora-13b, zephyr-1.2. goal: agree prioritization and owners for bring-up + basic quant experiments. please add scores in the intake sheet by EOD Thu :calendar: 

josh: can we include a quant fragility metric? some models look good full-precision but collapse at 4-bit. add as a separate column in the sheet.

priya: +1 on fragility. also want a quick canary cost estimate (1k rps 95th p99 tail) so we know Dedicated vs hosted tradeoffs.

lina: added fragility and canary-cost columns. my suggested lightweight scoring rubric below (open to tweaks):

lina: ```
quality: 0-10 (evals + hallucination rate)
latency: 0-10 (normalized to our infra targets)
cost: 0-10 (tokens * perf)
fragility: 0-10 (drop when quantized)
security/privacy: 0-10 (PII leakage risk)
score = round(0.35*quality + 0.25*latency + 0.2*cost + 0.15*fragility + 0.05*security,2)
```

eval-bot: auto-report: atlas-7b quick bench: quality 7.8, latency 6.5 (baseline infra), cost 6.0, fragility observed 2. quant test: 4-bit causes 18% F1 drop on convo-eval. full logs: https://ci.internal/reports/atlas-7b/summary

marc: I can own the 4-bit run for atlas-7b. will run both PTQ and QAT on the dev pool tomorrow. assigning task to marc.

ryan: FYI aurora-13b maps to roadmap NLU-2026-Q2 for search ranking; if its quality is close to atlas but scales better, we should bump it higher even if cost slightly worse.

sophia: hallucination check: zephyr-1.2 had odd reference errors in multi-hop QA tests last week (noted in evals). that's a regression risk for KB use-cases. we should mark it with a red flag.

josh: minor nit: let's add an "integration friction" 0-5 column (model changes to tokenizers, special tokens, new tokenizer libs) — we've wasted cycles before.

lina: good call — added integration friction (0-5). updated score weights: bumped security->0.05, fragility->0.15, integration friction not weighted but used as tiebreaker.

priya: owners suggestion: atlas -> marc (quant + canary), aurora -> ryan (tasked for perf/roadmap), zephyr -> sophia (QA + hallucination eval). 

lina: perfect. next steps:
- marc: run PTQ/QAT on atlas, post 4-bit summary and perf numbers (due Tue)
- ryan: full perf vs cost sim for aurora and mapping to Dedicated tiers (due Wed)
- sophia: extended hallucination tests + few-shot stress tests for zephyr (due Wed)
- everyone: fill intake sheet by EOD Thu with requested columns (fragility, canary-cost, integration friction)

lina: if any objections to owners or weighting shout now, otherwise i'll lock the intake and create canary tickets on Fri. :thumbsup:

marc: no objections. starting runs now. :gear:

ryan: sounds good, i'll start the perf sims.

sophia: copied. I'll add examples that triggered hallucinations to the eval set.

eval-bot: reminder: existing model-regression-monitor will alert if new canary increases hallucination rate >3% compared to baseline.

lina: thanks team — closing thread for triage. will post the locked prioritization snapshot once the sheet fills. :white_check_mark:
